name: Pelts for the guild
description: The warrior guild's hall is new timber and an empty wall. Eirik Stonehand wants four wolf pelts from the Frostmere Wilds to line it.
objective: Wolf pelts from the Frostmere Wilds
reward: 15 copper, 40 experience, and your choice of a wolf-head helm or a wolf-hide jerkin

name: Teeth at the Gate
description: Frost wolves are on the roads outside every gate. Sigrun wants them culled. Old Brand Kettilsson, by the north gate, will take five pelts.
objective: Five wolf pelts for Old Brand
reward: 25 copper and 60 experience from Old Brand

name: The Missing Scout
description: A scout did not come back from the frozen camp north of the gate. The fire is cold. Something was written down.
objective: Read the journal at the frozen scout camp and tell Sigrun

name: Icebound Cairns
description: The journal spoke of blue light, and the cairns are full of barrow-dead. Put eight of them down. Yrsa, in Sigrid's hall, has a blade for the one who does.
objective: Barrow-dead put down in the Icebound Cairns
reward: Yrsa's rune blade, 40 copper, and 120 experience

name: The Rimeheart
description: Blue lights under the ice at Rimeheart Lake. A shade there wears the name of Ysolde of the Black Ice. It is not the woman in the vault past the Fang, and it is not Ingrid. End the shade and come back.

name: The Open Road
description: The ridge north of the Frostmere Wilds is open. Frostfang Reach, the Ogre Highlands, starts past the line. Kara Holm keeps the fire at Hearthpass. Tell her Sigrun still counts the passes.
objective: Speak to Kara Holm at Hearthpass

name: Wolves of the Pass
description: Highland wolves work the south road of Frostfang Reach. Kara wants eight of them down before they decide the outpost is a den.

name: Scouts on the Ridge
description: Ogre scouts have been counting Hearthpass the way Kara counts them. Six is the number she asked for.

name: Grimhild's Toll
description: Grimhild the Toll holds the west road through the Broken Fangs. She is not a common raider, and she does not stay down for long. End the toll.

name: Shards on the Ice
description: Frost trolls walk the Tarn of Shards. Orm wants six of them off the ice before he will call the shore safe enough to sketch.

name: One Tusk
description: Skarn One-Tusk is seen on the climb to the Fang, and then not again for a long while. Kara wants that gap to start with you.

name: The Fang
description: Vargan Frostfang keeps the high cleft. He is the war-chief of the highland ogres, not a servant of the Shadow King. Put him down and bring word back to the fire.
reward: The Frostfang axe, 150 copper, and 700 experience
